# Forge 恢复与规则审核验收

以下是本地界面验收用的两只虚构生物。两只生物的能力来源均完整列在各自段落；不需要创建世界自定义状态。未实现的光照和受伤解除限定交由 GM。

## 生物一：Recovery Stalker

Medium Fey, Neutral

Armor Class 15
Hit Points 90 (12d8 + 36)
Speed 30 ft.

STR 18 (+4) DEX 14 (+2) CON 16 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 10 (+0)

Senses passive Perception 11
Languages Common
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +3

Actions

Echo Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. A creature struck by this claw is Frightened for one minute. After finishing each of its own turns, the affected creature may make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. A successful save ends this Frightened effect.

## 生物二：Review Sentinel

Medium Fey, Neutral

Armor Class 15
Hit Points 90 (12d8 + 36)
Speed 30 ft.

STR 18 (+4) DEX 14 (+2) CON 16 (+3) INT 10 (+0) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 10 (+0)

Senses passive Perception 11
Languages Common
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +3

Actions

Quiet Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. 被这一爪击中的目标陷入目盲，维持两轮。每次自己的回合结束时，目标可以选择进行 DC 13 体质豁免；成功则结束这次目盲。

Twilight Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. 被这一爪命中的目标陷入恐慌，持续一分钟。只有目标处于昏暗光照中时，它才能在自己的回合结束时进行 DC 10 感知豁免，成功则结束恐慌；如果目标受到任何伤害，这次恐慌也立即结束。光照限制及受伤结束由 GM 裁定。
